config.label: Mistral API key from https://console
config.description: Mistral API key from https://console.mistral.ai/. Model-specific usage and rate limits depend on the organization tier.

config.label: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, TGI, LiteLLM, internal gateway)
config.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, TGI, LiteLLM, internal gateway). Setting it routes every call there instead of api.mistral.ai and switches the server to the self-hosted profile.

config.label: Tool surface to expose: core (default), admin, workflows, metier-docs, self-hosted
config.description: Tool surface to expose: core (default), admin, workflows, metier-docs, self-hosted. Overrides what MISTRAL_BASE_URL would infer.

config.label: Default chat and structured-extraction model when a call omits model
config.description: Default chat and structured-extraction model when a call omits model. Useful for account-specific availability and self-hosted model ids.
